features.summary: Personal IM settings group connection cards for display while retaining per-connection binding and unbinding semantics.
boundaries: A binding does not span separate connections or bots.

features.summary: Introduce a verified IM-instance boundary before enabling identity reuse or dynamic direct-message routing across separate bot connections.
doneWhen: A trusted instance association exists for each participating connection.
Cross-connection identity routing checks that association and live RBAC.
